artefacts.caption: Coverage for the exactly centred terminal-call martingale and the always-wait policy, with 5,000 independent repetitions per path count. Bars are Wilson 95% intervals. Clipping caps are selected on an independent pilot; coverage is measured against the disclosed numerical policy-loss target.

Mean upper-limit excess above the two-right policy-loss target 1.156991, under the same simulation design. Both axes are logarithmic. The ordinate measures excess above the target, rather than an interval width.

Matched exercise-policy gain for the public max-call process. Each degree-2 full-state polynomial policy uses 50,000 training paths and 200,000 independent evaluation paths. Bars are approximate pointwise 95% Student intervals conditional on the fitted policy. Cases share a seed layout; the intervals make no simultaneous or independent-case claim.

Fitted two-asset max-call policy margin at t=1. Positive margins favour exercise. The full saved 41 by 41 state grid is shown; this is not an optimal exercise boundary. Polynomial extrapolation can be inaccurate outside dense training support.

Fitted two-asset max-call policy margin at t=1. Positive margins favour exercise. The full saved 41 by 41 state grid is shown; this is not an optimal exercise boundary. Polynomial extrapolation can be inaccurate outside dense training support. The 3D surface uses exactly the same margin values as the heatmap.

replicated_refinement.interpretation: Descriptive matched-fit comparisons at a common required path-gap width. Strategy order alternates. Established comparator execution is separate; midpoint standard errors, simulator law and statistical coverage are not computer-certified.
replicated_refinement.comparison_scope: Comparator gap minus adaptive hinge gap for the same frozen policy identifies relative expected dual slack; neither absolute policy shortfall nor an improved exercise policy is identified.
replicated_refinement.mean_certificate_scope: Arithmetic enclosures of retained sample means at exact binary input states. They do not enclose population means, simulator law or statistical coverage.
replicated_refinement.sampling_scope: Across-fit standard errors use eight independently fitted policy/value-function pairs. Within-fit standard errors of paired interval midpoints are approximate conditional diagnostics; 2,048 paths are not 2,048 independent fitted models.
replicated_refinement.cost_scope: Hinge budgets charge their complete preparation and assessment including policy checks. Polynomial verified budgets charge common policy and outer preparation, their own value simulation, targets and appropriate regression, their independently executed verified assessment, and policy validation. Hybrid interior setup is reconstructed from measured phases; file I/O and process start-up are excluded.

frozen_extension.sampling_scope: Eight previously trained policy/value-function pairs are held fixed. The degree-three hybrid was selected from the preceding comparison before this fresh evaluation. Conditional standard errors use independent new streams given those fits and that selection. Across-fit standard errors are descriptive dispersion combining retained-fit heterogeneity and evaluation noise, not confidence intervals or new training replications.
frozen_extension.cost_scope: New assessment and policy validation are measured anew. Full standalone budgets are reconstructed from retained setup phases, which are not rerun; the previous outer preparation is replaced by new outer preparation. Each arm charges its own validation. File serialisation and process start-up are excluded.
frozen_extension.mean_certificate_scope: Exact arithmetic enclosures concern retained sample means at supplied binary states. They do not enclose population means, simulator law or statistical coverage.
frozen_extension.comparison_scope: Hybrid gap minus adaptive hinge gap for the same frozen policy measures relative dual slack. A smaller assessor gap does not identify an improved exercise policy or absolute policy shortfall.

uniform_allocation.comparison_scope: The stronger common-width controls and adaptive refinement enclose the same unchanged ideal hinge gain at a common required width. Actual achieved widths and measured costs differ.
uniform_allocation.sampling_scope: Eight retained fits and their existing 1,024-path samples are reused. No new draws or fits are generated; this is not independent confirmation from a new sampling experiment.
uniform_allocation.cost_scope: New work is complete assessment including input and policy validation and result construction. Standalone budgets are reconstructed by adding retained preparation once; simulation and fitting are not rerun. Common controls retain fuller query traces; measured CPU does not isolate allocation-rule runtime. Process start-up, imports and artifact I/O are excluded.
uniform_allocation.execution_scope: Successful per-fit assessment measurements span two execution sessions: five retained fits from the original attempt and three successful continuation fits. The failed original fit-five CPU is unavailable and is excluded. The continuation whole-workflow CPU is a separate measurement. No new paths or fits were generated.

restricted_initial_right.interpretation: Removal of an exactly zero initial reward changes the dual evaluator but preserves the exercise policy and stopping value. Retained signed gap intervals are unchanged; no population improvement, sampling coverage or computational saving is claimed.

multivariate_monetary.cost_scope: All original generated and assessed rows remain charged, including the exposed prefix. Original required-prefix charges are preserved verbatim. I add the entire measured correction workflow to each decision as a conservative after-run reconstruction, rather than a chronological stopping cost or an allocation of shared verification costs. The whole-study cost counts the original preparation, original assessment and correction workflows once each; historical training remains in the original standalone charges. Independent audit costs and final summary serialisation are not included.
multivariate_monetary.source_scope: Published homogeneous five-asset mathematical benchmark. Aggregate model-based results only; no provider observations, binary paths, coefficients or native ledgers.
